messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Stan and RStan v2.0.0
parts:
The Stan Development Team is happy to announce Stan v2.0.0 and RStan v2.0.0.

This is a major release that breaks backward compatibility for models with variable names that conflict with built-in function names. For more information, see the release notes:

    https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/blob/v2.0.0/RELEASE-NOTES.txt


For those using the command-line version, the options have changed. The new command-line options are documented in Chapter 4 of the Stan User's Guide and Reference Manual:

   https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases/download/v2.0.0/stan-reference-2.0.0.pdf


Please don't hesitate to contact the user's group mailing list with questions, comments, or suggestions.


--- Stan Development Team

messages.author: 54788cf3a8eb8916
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Stan and RStan v2.0.0
parts:
Great news folks!

I've just installed here on 64-bit ubuntu 12.04 and it works fine for the 8schools model on https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

However, I did have an issue... I had an old version of rstan on the machine, so I ran the code to un-install it.  Then in the *same* session I installed rstan - no problem.  But then I continued and loaded rstan and tried to run the 8schools example and got compilation problems  - this was resolved when I started a new session - I'm guessing that it was something to do with having two versions of rstan half in the first session.

Looking more carefully I see that the documentation *does* say that the R session should be restarted! I just missed it the first time through in my eagerness to see the new version of rstan running! :-)

cheers,
Seán
